requirements.text: MUST HAVE – Hands-on Semantic/Context Experience: Candidate needs actual hands-on project experience with a semantic layer, context layer, knowledge graph, knowledge system/engine, retrieval system, or closely related technology. Conceptual knowledge alone is not enough. Do not reject solely because they lack several years; the manager specifically said hands-on depth matters more than tenure. Pasted text

DO NOT SEND: Traditional ML/Data Scientists whose experience is primarily predictive modeling and who have no semantic/context/knowledge-layer experience; pure Data Engineers focused primarily on pipelines/ETL and production infrastructure; candidates who only have theoretical GenAI/semantic knowledge without hands-on work; or candidates who require clearly defined requirements and have little evidence of independently scoping ambiguous problems.

– Data/Analytics Technical Foundation: Must be comfortable working hands-on with SQL/data analysis and have enough technical depth to test use cases and work effectively with Data Science/Data Engineering partners. They do not need to be a full-scale production Data Engineer.

A proactive, end-to-end approach, and comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy SQL and Python sufficient to work on a data science team; SQL forms part of the content itself Experience building with modern AI tooling; transferable experience matters more than any specific vendor Strong cross-team partnerships, including outside your own organization
